label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 66
title: MVP: project Git check-ins page (commits: date/time/#/PR/details, tags, branches, develop merges)
body: A per-project Git page tracking source control activity: table/timeline of CHECK-INS with date, time, commit short #, full hash, author, message/details, files changed (+/-), branch, and PR # (when present); TAGS list (RC/release); BRANCHES with ahead/behind vs develop/main and which map to which stage; MERGE events (feat/fix -> develop, develop -> main/release). Filter by branch/author/date/PR; link to the artifact/stage that produced each check-in. Depends on backend BE (BI-0089 forge:git-history-api).
